inference: These counts describe conditioning exposure. They do not prove that native T5 bypass caused C collapse or that a different dropout recipe will improve generation.
candidate_if_needed: For R10 only after R9 evidence: retain existing joint-null CFG training and add a bounded positive-Qwen/native-text-null training mode with the same real-video FM target. This could assign more generation learning to Q/C without training wrong conditions to fail or adding arbitrary diversity, verifier rewards, or extra data.

attribution_limit: Native-text-only dropout addresses the generation contribution of the Qwen/Q/C path as a whole. Because its positive input retains the literal request, this alone cannot prove use of correct reasoning beyond request information, or repair unsupported Qwen claims. Retain separate correct/unrelated/empty and no-C controls; do not worsen control outputs deliberately.
